p.src: 1  Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

en: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;
u.src: 1  Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

p.src: 2  but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

en: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.
u.src: 2  but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

en: 1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

p.src: 3  He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

en: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.
u.src: 3  He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

p.src: 4  The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

en: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
u.src: 4  The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

p.src: 5  Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

en: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
u.src: 5  Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

p.src: 6  For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

en: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
u.src: 6  For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.
